_comment: Source text metadata for GEPR-LINAN dataset. Corrected 2025 to match actual editions and digitisation sources used (Shidian Guji, shidianguji.com). All texts are in the public domain; see dataset README for copyright statement.

ind_corpus.author: 周淙 (Zhou Chong)
ind_corpus.description_en: The earliest surviving Lin'an gazetteer, compiled by Zhou Chong during the Qiandao reign period. Covers the administrative geography, official buildings, and urban layout of Lin'an.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 周必大 (Zhou Bida)
ind_corpus.description_en: Miscellaneous notes by the scholar-official Zhou Bida, containing observations on Lin'an geography, institutions, and place names.
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 曹勋 (Cao Xun)
ind_corpus.description_en: A monographic record of Liuhe Pagoda (Six Harmonies Tower) on the Qiantang River. Preserved in the collected works Songyin Ji (松隐集) by Cao Xun; used here from the Siku Quanshu edition, pp. 5–9.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in 《松隐集》by Cao Xun; Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition, pp. 5–9
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Song Dynasty work, >800 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 原作者不详 (Unknown original author); compiled by 马如龙 (Ma Rulong) in Hangzhou Fuzhi
ind_corpus.dynasty: Original: Southern Song Dynasty; compiled edition: Qing Dynasty
ind_corpus.approx_date: Song Dynasty (original, date unknown); compiled edition: Qing Dynasty (printed 1686 CE)
ind_corpus.description_en: A systematic survey of government offices established in Lin'an after the Southern Migration (nan du). Original author unknown; preserved in and used from Ma Rulong's Hangzhou Fuzhi (杭州府志), Kangxi 25th year edition, vol. 5, pp. 41–44.
ind_corpus.source_edition: (Qing) 马如龙 (Ma Rulong), 《杭州府志》卷五, Kangxi 25th year (1686 CE) printed edition, pp. 41–44
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (compiled edition printed 1686 CE, >300 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 陈世崇 (Chen Shichong)
ind_corpus.approx_date: Southern Song Dynasty (13th century CE); preserved in Yuan Dynasty host text
ind_corpus.description_en: Records of the temporary imperial palaces used by the Southern Song court during and after its southward migration. Preserved in (Yuan) Tao Zongyi's Nancun Chuogeng Lu (南村辍耕录), vol. 18; used here from the Sibucongkan Wu-Pan family Pangxi Studio Yuan-dynasty printed edition, pp. 12–14.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in (元) 陶宗义 (Tao Zongyi), 《南村辍耕录》卷十八; 四部丛刊吴潘氏滂憙斋藏元刊本, pp. 12–14
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song original; Yuan Dynasty host text, >650 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 潜说友 (Qian Shuoyou)
ind_corpus.description_en: The most comprehensive Lin'an gazetteer surviving from the Song period, comprising 93 volumes. Provides exhaustive documentation of Lin'an's geography, institutions, buildings, rivers, and urban structure.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 周密 (Zhou Mi), original; 朱庭焕 (Zhu Tinghuan), supplement
ind_corpus.approx_date: Southern Song Dynasty (original, 13th century CE); supplement: Ming Dynasty (14th–17th century CE)
ind_corpus.genre: Urban Miscellany / Augmented Edition (增补笔记)
ind_corpus.description_en: An expanded edition of Zhou Mi's Wulin Jiushi with added materials on Lin'an's urban geography, palaces, streets, and landmarks.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song original >700 years ago; Ming supplement >400 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 徐一夔 (Xu Yikui)
ind_corpus.description_en: A scholarly study of the Song imperial palace system in Lin'an by Ming scholar Xu Yikui. Preserved in his collected works Shifeng Gao (始丰稿); used here from the Siku Quanshu edition, pp. 2–5.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in 《始丰稿》by Xu Yikui; Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition, pp. 2–5
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Ming Dynasty work, >500 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 祝穆 (Zhu Mu)
ind_corpus.description_en: A comprehensive Song geographic encyclopaedia covering prefectures and notable sites across the empire. Volume 1 focuses on Lin'an prefecture.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 郎瑛 (Lang Ying)
ind_corpus.description_en: A survey of Song dynasty palaces in Hangzhou by Ming scholar Lang Ying. Preserved in his Qi Xiu Lei Gao (七修类稿), vol. 2. Edition details of the physical copy are unknown; accessed via the CADAL digital collection on Shidian Guji, p. 1.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in 《七修类稿》卷二 by Lang Ying; physical edition date and publisher unknown; CADAL digitised copy, p. 1
ind_corpus.digitisation_source: Shidian Guji (识典古籍) via CADAL (中国高校数字图书馆), shidianguji.com
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Ming Dynasty work, >400 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 郎瑛 (Lang Ying)
ind_corpus.description_en: A survey of Song dynasty ritual institutions in Hangzhou by Ming scholar Lang Ying. Preserved in his Qi Xiu Lei Gao (七修类稿), vol. 2. Edition details of the physical copy are unknown; accessed via CADAL on Shidian Guji, p. 1.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in 《七修类稿》卷二 by Lang Ying; physical edition date and publisher unknown; CADAL digitised copy, p. 1
ind_corpus.digitisation_source: Shidian Guji (识典古籍) via CADAL (中国高校数字图书馆), shidianguji.com
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Ming Dynasty work, >400 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 郎瑛 (Lang Ying)
ind_corpus.description_en: A survey of residences of meritorious ministers and court officials in Song Hangzhou, by Ming scholar Lang Ying. Preserved in his Qi Xiu Lei Gao (七修类稿), vol. 2; CADAL digitised copy, p. 2.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in 《七修类稿》卷二 by Lang Ying; physical edition date and publisher unknown; CADAL digitised copy, p. 2
ind_corpus.digitisation_source: Shidian Guji (识典古籍) via CADAL (中国高校数字图书馆), shidianguji.com
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Ming Dynasty work, >400 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 郎瑛 (Lang Ying)
ind_corpus.description_en: A survey of Song dynasty government offices in Hangzhou, by Ming scholar Lang Ying. Preserved in his Qi Xiu Lei Gao (七修类稿), vol. 2; CADAL digitised copy, pp. 2–4.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in 《七修类稿》卷二 by Lang Ying; physical edition date and publisher unknown; CADAL digitised copy, pp. 2–4
ind_corpus.digitisation_source: Shidian Guji (识典古籍) via CADAL (中国高校数字图书馆), shidianguji.com
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Ming Dynasty work, >400 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 吴自牧 (Wu Zimu)
ind_corpus.description_en: A detailed description of Lin'an's urban life, institutions, and spatial organisation written near the end of the Southern Song.
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 周密 (Zhou Mi)
ind_corpus.approx_date: Southern Song / Yuan Dynasty (13th century CE)
ind_corpus.description_en: Zhou Mi's memoir of Lin'an's urban splendour, covering palaces, festivals, markets, and gardens.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song / Yuan Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 施谔 (Shi E), original; 胡敬 (Hu Jing), collated reconstruction
ind_corpus.approx_date: Southern Song Dynasty (13th century CE); extant text reconstructed in Qing Dynasty
ind_corpus.description_en: A Lin'an gazetteer compiled during the Chunyou reign, preceding the Xianchun edition. Only fragments survive; reconstructed by Qing scholar Hu Jing. The 1900 Ding-family Jiahui Hall edition was used.
ind_corpus.source_edition: 光绪庚子（1900年）钱塘嘉惠堂丁氏刊 (Guangxu Gengzi [1900 CE] Qiantang Jiahui Hall Ding-family edition)
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song original >700 years ago; Qing reconstruction >100 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 西湖老人 (Old Man of West Lake; anonymous pen name)
ind_corpus.approx_date: Southern Song Dynasty (13th century CE); preserved in Ming Dynasty Yongle Dadian
ind_corpus.description_en: An anonymous record of Lin'an's prosperity and bustling urban landscape. Preserved in the Yongle Dadian (永乐大典), vol. 7630 [18th Yang — Hang]; used here from the Jiajing (嘉靖) manuscript copy, pp. 1–18.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Collected in (明) 解缙 (Jie Jin) comp., 《永乐大典》卷7630【十八阳·杭】; Jiajing (嘉靖) manuscript copy (副本), pp. 1–18
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song original; Ming Dynasty Yongle Dadian >600 years ago)

ind_corpus.author: 耐得翁 (Nai De Weng; anonymous pen name)
ind_corpus.description_en: One of the earliest surviving descriptions of Lin'an as a capital city, covering markets, entertainment quarters, religious establishments, and urban districts.
ind_corpus.source_edition: Qing Dynasty Siku Quanshu (四库全书) edition
ind_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago)

ood_corpus.author: 王象之 (Wang Xiangzhi)
ood_corpus.description_en: A large-scale Song geographic encyclopedia covering all prefectures of the empire. Volumes 1–2 (used as OOD data) cover Lin'an prefecture but represent an independent stylistic and structural tradition distinct from the IND corpus.
ood_corpus.rationale_for_ood: Though the subject matter overlaps with IND texts, Yuedi Jisheng was compiled by a different author with a distinct encyclopaedic methodology covering the entire empire rather than focusing locally on Lin'an. No text or volume appears in both IND and OOD corpora.
ood_corpus.source_edition: 末清李韵亭重修本 (Late Qing revised edition by Li Yunting)
ood_corpus.copyright_status: Public domain (Southern Song Dynasty work, >700 years ago; revised edition late Qing, >100 years ago)

digitisation_process.platform_description: A publicly accessible digital repository for classical Chinese texts. No login required.
digitisation_process.method: Page-image scans of the specified historical editions were downloaded from Shidian Guji. Optical character recognition (OCR) was applied, followed by systematic manual correction of recognition errors. Items 10–13 (essays from Qi Xiu Lei Gao) were accessed via the CADAL (China Academic Digital Associative Library, 中国高校数字图书馆) collection hosted on Shidian Guji.
digitisation_process.copyright_statement: All source texts are in the public domain. Faithful digital reproductions of public domain texts do not attract new copyright protection under Chinese law (which requires originality [独创性] for copyright to subsist). The dataset releases only annotation layers (entity spans and relation labels) under CC BY 4.0; the full source texts are not included in the dataset release.
